summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completed acquisition of a 1.64-acre automotive service property in Overland Park, Kansas for $5,800,000 cash from unaffiliated seller 14939 Metcalf Ave., LLC. The deal, signed June 8, 2026 and closed July 29, 2026, was funded from cash on hand and held via a Delaware statutory trust (DST). The company expects to offer DST beneficial interests to accredited investors under Regulation D, using proceeds to redeem its interests. Watch for upcoming Item 9.01 financial statements and the private placement's success for capital recovery.
